item.title: Mardaani 3 Box Office Collections: Rani Mukerji film grows on Sunday, rakes in 17cr weekend in India
item.description: Mardaani 3 collected Rs. 7 crore nett approx on its third day, and with that, it wrapped its opening weekend at Rs. 16.75 crore nett approx. The Rani Mukerji starrer had a decent growth on Saturday but made good gains on Sunday of roughly 20 per cent. One generally doesn’t associate this kind of jump with films in this zone, although this probably has a bit more mass appeal than the regular small/midscale urban multiplex films. item.description: Border 2 collected Rs. 20 crore nett on its second Sunday. With that, Sunny Deol headlined war film closed its second weekend at Rs. 46 crore nett approx. That marks a 60 per cent drop from its first weekend, which is a good hold.
